ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; note the driver's no-show claim as not established (continuous in-radius wait after the "I'm Here" tap was 2 min 55 s, under the 3-minute threshold).
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the only messages are two routine, timestamped trip-coordination messages [F9][F10][F11]; the driver's written statement [F12] is a plain factual account. No threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation — no SAFE-1/SAFE-2 trigger.

Branch (NS-0): this is a completed-booking no-show dispute with cancelled_by = driver [F4]; NS-1/NS-2 govern the $6.61 fee. Trip was RydeX (non-metered), cancellation policy applies [F4][F7].

NS-1 test of the driver's no-show claim:
(i) Arrival tap: the driver pressed "I'm Here" at 13:02:35 [F6]. Note the platform separately logged arrival at 13:01:00 [F5]; the record distinguishes platform_auto from the driver's tap, and the driver tap exists here.
(ii) Location at tap: 39 m from the pickup point at that moment [F6] — within 200 m, satisfied (driver also stayed within 200 m afterwards [F6], closest approach 38 m [F1]).
(iii) Continuous > 3 min wait inside the radius after the tap: only 2 min 55 s (13:02:35 → 13:05:30) inside 200 m [F6][F5]. The default threshold is > 3 minutes (≥ 3:01); the arrival log at 13:01:00 and the cumulative 4 min 30 s within 200 m before cancellation [F2] cannot substitute, because NS-1(iii) excludes time spent near the pickup before the tap. The stationary period 13:02:15–13:05:30 (3 min 15 s) [F3] begins 20 s BEFORE the tap, so it does not yield a post-tap band either.
Record carries no alternative no-show threshold (free_wait_time is a waiting-fee trigger, not a no-show threshold), so the default 3-minute rule applies.

Result: (iii) fails → NS-2: the $6.61 cancellation fee is refunded in full, refund_full, amount $6.61 [F7]. NS-2's extra flag_account applies only when the driver tapped "I'm Here" while GPS showed him outside the pickup radius (m_from_pickup_at_tap > 200) — here the tap was at 39 m [F6], so no flag on that ground. Driver's profile shows 1 prior upheld no-show dispute in 90 d [F17], but RD-6 is a route-deviation clause and this case's failure is the opposite direction (fee refunded, no route violation), so no account flag is added; profile facts cannot decide the case anyway.

Traffic/weather facts [F13][F14][F15] are irrelevant: no route deviation is alleged. Rider profile [F16] not used to decide.

Evidence status: sufficient — GPS/timeline cover the whole window through cancellation, chat is fully timestamped, no gaps.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's post-trip statement claims he waited more than 3 minutes after tapping 'I'm Here'; the timeline/GPS records [F5][F6] show only 2 min 55 s of in-radius time after the tap, so the claim fails NS-1(iii) and the fee is refunded under NS-2.

Pre-tap presence (platform arrival 13:01:00, 4 min 30 s cumulative within 200 m [F2][F5]) is a statement/record of proximity, not 'waiting' under NS-1(iii), which counts only continuous in-radius time after the tap.
